independentMemory.policy: Each nonidentity mapping costs one. An ordinary displaced initial is already charged; no second default fee. A/E/O shared physical carrier counted once. contract.annealing: One chain per family and cost axis, 100-new-score coarse/fine cycles; far restarts after each complete cycle; initials fixed per family; pin e->E for P8/U8.
contract.neighborhood: Final single moves, pair swaps and whole-key group swaps. Strict D2, M41/M42 and pin-e constraint checked after every atomic proposal. Finite search, not global optimality.
